_comment: Reference only - not read by any code yet. Field names/structure are Zoom's Cloud Recording API, GET /meetings/{meetingId}/recordings (publicly documented at developers.zoom.us; not live-verified this session - WebFetch to developers.zoom.us was blocked by network policy, so treat this as 'from memory of the public spec', same caveat the other fixtures are explicit about avoiding). This is what a Real* meeting-metadata/transcript reader would call once this lane has a meetingId to call it with (see plan.md and FixtureZoomMeetingMetadataReader's javadoc for that blocker) - it lists ALL of a meeting's recording assets (video, audio, chat, transcript) in one response; the transcript is the recording_files[] entry with file_type=TRANSCRIPT, file_extension=VTT, recording_type=audio_transcript. download_url needs the OAuth access token appended as a query param (?access_token=...) or sent as a Bearer header, depending on the app type - it 404s without it. VALUES are fabricated placeholders.
